summary: AngloGold Ashanti plc filed a Form 6-K earnings release for Q2 2026, announcing a $2.0bn share repurchase program approved by shareholders on 23 July 2026, alongside an interim dividend of $364m (72 US cents per share). The company also completed a $666m bond buyback on 16 April 2026, reducing gross debt. The buyback supplements existing dividends and aligns capital allocation with North American peers. Watch for execution pace and impact on share price support, as the program provides an additional shareholder return mechanism.
